QuestInfo.name: The Lava Mug
QuestInfo.0: The guard of the Abandoned Mine, #b#p2030008##k told me to go see #b#p2020000##k if I want a container that can hold lava.
QuestInfo.2: With help from #b#p2020000##k, I was able to make a container that'll hold lava. Let's go back to the Abandoned Mine.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2020000##k is trying to make a bowl to hold lava. He needs #b#t4000081#s and a #t4021009##k to make it.

0.0: Hmm... If I, #b#p2020000##k can't make it, nobody can. Do you want anything else?

yes.0: A container that holds lava? What are you going to do with it? Drink lava? You're out of your mind! But whoever you are, I'm going to make it for you. It will be a nice challenge for me.
yes.1: You need to gather all ingredients I need. #b2 #t4021007# , 30 #t4000081#, 1 #t4021009##k.

no.0: If you can't, I can't make the container!

1.0: Hmm. If I have ingredients, I can make it now. The most important thing is ingredients. Usually, they can't make it because they don't know how to gather what I need.

yes.0: You know, I don't know why you want to drink lava, but good luck! I made the best container for you. Are you going to the Abandoned Mine? There must be something there, a keeper...

npc.0: Hey, I don't have enough ingredients. I'll need #b30 #t4000081#, 2 #t4021007# , 1 #t4021009##k. If I don't get them, I can't make it. Gather everything!

lost.0: Did you lose #b#t4001109##k? You have to recycle it as it can't be broken. I made some glass bottles. I'll give it to you. Don't lose it.
